text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening calls as of 0838 CDT.

CANOLA - C$1.50 to C$3.00 a tonne higher on continued dry conditions cutting canola yield potential with spill over support from CBOT corn which was called to open limit up on a bullishly construed production report. November WCE canola crush profit margin fell to -19.87 Monday from -14.47 Friday. Canada's dollar opened down at C$1.3951, fell to 83.03 yen and fell to 1.3332 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$0.80 to C$1.30 up in the November to reallign the September-November spread after it closed Monday at C$14.

WESTERN BARLEY - C$2.50 to C$5.00 a tonne higher on CBOT corn calls and the U.S. Department of Agriculture's 424 million bushel reduction in U.S. corn output forecast. Trade talk of low test weights in Alberta's barley crop should continue to be supportive.
FEED WHEAT - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne up on spill over support from WCE barley and CBOT corn calls.
OATS - Steady to US$0.50 a tonne higher on spill over support from allied grain markets.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
